Usage: astryx theme list [options]

List themes available to add

Options:
  --package <package>  Show only themes owned by this package
  -h, --help           display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  a bundled or installed theme descriptor cannot be read

Examples:
  # List available themes
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme list --json
  # List one integration package
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme list --package @acme/themes

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme-list
